# An angle's supplement

Two lines from the origin at `θ = atan(4/3)` under `angle θ`. Moving the
second line's end to (−6, −8) reverses it: the segments now meet at the
supplement `π − θ`, and the directed angle is `θ + π`, where the residual
`sin(φ − θ)` is zero again. `cos(φ − θ)` goes from 1 to −1: a flip
(ADR-0006).
